snippet.title: Blighthold - Lovecraftian Dieselpunk City Builder Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Blighthold is an upcoming City Builder set in a WWI inspired Dieselpunk world. Lead your people, sign laws, defend against Lovecraftian horrors, and uncover the Eldritch truth under the roots.

Wishlist now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4659730/Blighthold
